There are 60 minutes in an hour.

Regarding the competitor's strategy: Streamline Autos' direct-to-consumer (DTC) model for electric vehicles poses a significant threat to traditional automotive sales structures. By eliminating dealership markups, they can offer lower prices, which may pressure our pricing margins and force a strategic review of our own cost structure. Furthermore, their direct engagement allows for real-time data collection on consumer preferences, enabling faster product iteration and more targeted marketing. To mitigate this impact, we should consider enhancing our own digital sales channels, improving customer experience through technology, and potentially exploring hybrid sales models that retain the benefits of dealership networks while incorporating more direct digital engagement.
